raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post-L4-L5 Herniation, No Heavy Spinal Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-injury"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Movement Quality" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest_press_machine 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row_machine 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band_pull_aparts 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_machine 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          bird_dog 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Mobility":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_chest_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          single_leg_calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_camel 2m
